name: Ellen

scaling.scaled: Lighter dumbbells and steady burpee pacing — pick a burpee cadence in round one you can still hold in the final round.
scaling.beginner: Cut the round count, keep the triplet structure, and use the lightest dumbbells in the gym without embarrassment.

origin.summary: A newer addition to the Girls canon: a triplet mixing burpees with dumbbell work, in the modern CrossFit.com style that folds dumbbells into the classic benchmark format. Part of CrossFit's original 'Girls' benchmark series — named workouts introduced by founder Greg Glassman starting in 2003, on the logic that anything that leaves you flat on your back deserves a name like a storm. They serve as repeatable fitness tests: revisit one every few months and the clock tells you whether you're fitter. First posted to CrossFit.com on 2021-01-10.

description: Three rounds of burpees, dumbbell snatches, and dumbbell thrusters — a dumbbell-only triplet in the mold of Fran's couplet, extended to three movements.
source_notes: crossfit.com/faq/wod (official CrossFit FAQ, 'Explain The Workouts with Names (the Girls)?'), retrieved 2026-07-08
